manifest.title: 校园吐槽
manifest.description: 考试、小组作业、宿舍与选课：校园英语短句

items.text: The midterm is next week and the slides are incomplete.
items.hint: 下周期中，课件却还不完整。

items.text: Group projects are unpaid management training.
items.hint: 小组作业是无偿的管理培训。

items.text: I reserved a library seat and lost it in five minutes.
items.hint: 我占了图书馆座位，五分钟就没了。

items.text: The cafeteria line is longer than my attention span.
items.hint: 食堂队伍比我的注意力还长。

items.text: My roommate treats midnight like lunchtime.
items.hint: 室友把午夜当午餐时间。

items.text: The professor said optional reading; the exam disagreed.
items.hint: 老师说选读，考试不这么认为。

items.text: I joined a club for fun and got a second calendar.
items.hint: 我为了好玩加入社团，结果多了一份日程。

items.text: The Wi-Fi dies right before I submit.
items.hint: 我要提交的前一秒 Wi-Fi 挂了。

items.text: Office hours are when every student discovers questions.
items.hint: 答疑时间一到，所有人都突然有问题。

items.text: My GPA cares more than my sleep schedule.
items.hint: GPA 比我的睡眠更在乎我。

items.text: The dorm dryer ate another sock.
items.hint: 宿舍烘干机又吃了一只袜子。

items.text: I printed the wrong PDF for the presentation.
items.hint: 演示时我打印错了 PDF。

items.text: The campus map looks simple until you are late.
items.hint: 校地图看着简单，直到你快迟到。

items.text: Peer review means polite confusion in comments.
items.hint: 互评就是评论里客气的困惑。

items.text: The lecture is recorded, so attendance became optional guilt.
items.hint: 课录了，出勤变成可选的愧疚。

items.text: I bought the textbook I will never open again.
items.hint: 我买了本再也不会打开的教材。

items.text: The lab report template fights with my figures.
items.hint: 实验报告模板和我的图打架。

items.text: My scholarship email arrived after I panicked.
items.hint: 奖学金邮件在我慌完之后才到。

items.text: The internship portal crashed on deadline day.
items.hint: 实习系统在截止日期当天崩了。

items.text: I studied the wrong chapter with perfect focus.
items.hint: 我全神贯注复习了错误的章节。

items.text: The bus to campus is late when it rains.
items.hint: 一下雨，去学校的公交就晚点。

items.text: My notes are complete; my understanding is not.
items.hint: 笔记齐全，理解却没有。

items.text: The group chat is active; the work is not.
items.hint: 群聊很活跃，活儿不活跃。

items.text: I need a quiet room and found a karaoke club instead.
items.hint: 我想找安静教室，却走进了卡拉 OK 社。

items.text: The final is cumulative, which means everything forever.
items.hint: 期末是累积考，意思是永远的一切。

items.text: I registered for classes and got a waiting-list lifestyle.
items.hint: 选课结果变成候补人生。

items.text: The coffee on campus is expensive and still weak.
items.hint: 学校咖啡又贵又淡。

items.text: My thesis outline has more versions than results.
items.hint: 论文大纲版本比结果还多。

items.text: The printer only jams for important forms.
items.hint: 打印机专挑重要表格卡纸。

items.text: I joined office hours and left with more homework.
items.hint: 去了答疑，带回了更多作业。

items.text: The syllabus says flexible; the rubric says strict.
items.hint: 大纲说灵活，评分细则说严格。

items.text: My backpack is a portable filing cabinet.
items.hint: 我的背包是便携文件柜。

items.text: The guest lecture was inspiring and ungraded, so empty.
items.hint: 嘉宾讲座很励志又不计分，所以很空。

items.text: I swapped night owl hours for morning exams.
items.hint: 我拿夜猫子作息去换早场考试。

items.text: The campus app has five menus for one task.
items.hint: 校园 App 一个任务要五个菜单。

items.text: My elective became the hardest class by accident.
items.hint: 选修课意外成了最难的课。

items.text: The rain started exactly when class ended.
items.hint: 刚好一下课就下雨。

items.text: I need three signatures and found one office open.
items.hint: 我需要三个签字，只找到一个办公室开门。

items.text: The study group turned into a gossip group.
items.hint: 学习小组变成了八卦小组。

items.text: My presentation clicker died mid-sentence.
items.hint: 演示翻页笔讲到一半没电了。

items.text: The dining hall calls it fusion; I call it mystery.
items.hint: 食堂叫融合菜，我叫神秘料理。

items.text: I booked a tutor and then understood the question too late.
items.hint: 约了家教，问题却理解得太晚。

items.text: The research survey needs fifty responses by tonight.
items.hint: 调研问卷今晚前要五十份回复。

items.text: My campus ID photo looks like a hostage photo.
items.hint: 校园卡照片像人质照。

items.text: The library fine is longer than the overdue days.
items.hint: 图书馆罚款天数比逾期还长。

items.text: I packed for a week and stayed for a day trip mindset.
items.hint: 我按一周收拾行李，却过着一日游心态。

items.text: The lecture hall AC makes summer feel like winter.
items.hint: 阶梯教室空调把夏天吹成冬天。

items.text: My graduation checklist has one more surprise form.
items.hint: 毕业清单总还有一张意外表格。

items.text: I came for knowledge and stayed for the free pizza.
items.hint: 我为知识而来，为免费披萨留下。

items.text: The campus pigeon has better lunch plans than me.
items.hint: 校园鸽子的午餐计划比我强。

items.text: I refreshed the grade portal like it is a stock app.
items.hint: 我刷成绩系统像刷股票软件。

items.text: The roommate agreement failed at dish duty.
items.hint: 室友公约在洗碗环节破产了。

items.text: My campus tour guide walked faster than my schedule.
items.hint: 校园导览走得比我的日程还快。

items.text: I need sleep, caffeine, and one more extension.
items.hint: 我需要睡眠、咖啡因，再加一次延期。

items.text: The alumni talk said hustle; my wallet said internship.
items.hint: 校友讲座谈拼搏，我的钱包谈实习。

items.text: I lost my umbrella to the campus weather gods again.
items.hint: 我的伞又献给了校园天气之神。

items.text: The class participation grade rewards the loudest take.
items.hint: 课堂参与分奖励声音最大的观点。

items.text: My planner is color-coded and still ignored.
items.hint: 计划本涂满颜色，依然被无视。

items.text: I studied abroad in the library basement this semester.
items.hint: 这学期我在图书馆地下室「留学」。

items.text: End of term, and my brain filed for vacation.
items.hint: 学期末了，大脑申请放假。
